description:
Make every test that plants or names a gate-run record build its path through `VirtualPath::gate_run_record`, so no test spells the record layout.

## Background

Tests spell the flat run layout literally: `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:2614-2616` (`gate-runs/evidence-probe`) and `:2722` (`gate-runs/corrupt/result.json` in an error message), `commands/mod.rs:4362` (`gate-runs/prior-run/result.json`), `storage/gate_runs.rs:34-38` (a run directory) and `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:2159-2234,2326-2391` (run directories and result files). The constructor takes `(&IssueId, &GateRunId)`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed test builds every gate-run record path through `VirtualPath::gate_run_record` and asserts on paths it builds, and no listed file spells `gate-runs/<run>` or `result.json`.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Gate-run test fixtures build record paths through the constructor
